title: Sources specs count the catalog, so every import breaks CI
description: features/sources asserted 'the catalog has N sources' and exact file counts per curated source; the ccMixter import (2166f0d) made it 62 and CI went red again. Specs now name sources the catalog must include and invariants every source keeps (files, credit, rights, source page; unique ids and paths; CC BY names its author; http files have urls).
